entries.description: A small desktop robot that brings an AI coding assistant to life, physically acting out when it reads files, thinks, writes code, and finishes work.

entries.conclusion: 状态反馈是主机AI事件的物理表达；没有完整机身语音对话；PCB当前为开发中。
